meta.title: Privacy mode
meta.description: Two asymmetric visibility modes. In NORMAL, plugins you mark private are unloaded so their tools never reach the tool catalog or the system prompt, and their workspaces and sessions stay out of the sidebar; PRIVATE sees the whole profile again. Sessions are archived, never deleted, and switching back restores exactly what was hidden. A PIN can gate entering PRIVATE.
